name: claudeconnect
notes: Bring your claude.ai chats over: Settings → Chats reads claude.ai's data export, and they show up in the sidebar. Carry on in any of them; the first reply reads the conversation so far.
Plan usage reads the latest numbers as soon as you open it, so there's no Refresh button anymore.
Plan usage no longer says you've hit a limit when you haven't: past a plan limit with usage credits on, replies carry on, and it says so.
Usage credits are on the Plan usage page: whether they're on, in use or used up, and a switch to stop this site from using them.
After an update or a settings change, "Updated" and "Reload" go away once the page has reloaded, and stay away until the next one.
Looks more like ChatGPT: one chat list, a sidebar that folds into a strip of icons, and copy buttons that show under a message when you point at it.
